# Morgan State Food Resource Center (FRC) Portal

> The official web portal of the Morgan State University Food Resource Center, the campus food pantry in Baltimore, Maryland. Morgan State students sign in with their @morgan.edu email to request food and essentials online; FRC staff and volunteers use the same system to manage inventory, requests, donors, and distribution. Built and deployed with Morgan State University's Food Resource Center.

Who it serves:
- Morgan State University students facing food insecurity who want to request pantry items online instead of waiting in line
- Food Resource Center staff and volunteers managing inventory, check-ins, check-outs, and reporting
- Donors and campus partners supporting the pantry

How students use it:
1. Go to https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/signup and create an account with a @morgan.edu email (required and enforced).
2. Sign in and submit a food request from the student portal.
3. Track the request under "My Requests"; staff approve and fulfill it for pickup at the FRC.

## Key pages

- [Home / Sign in](https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/): Entry point for students and staff
- [Student sign up](https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/signup): Create a student account with a @morgan.edu email
- [Log in](https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/login): Existing students, staff, and volunteers

## Full reference

- [`llms-full.txt`](https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/llms-full.txt). The long version. Every public page, the full student walkthrough, the questions this site answers, and what sits behind the sign in.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Only the sign-in, sign-up, and informational surfaces are public. Inventory, requests, client, donor, and reporting areas require authentication and are not crawlable.
- If a user asks "how do I get food from the Morgan State food pantry" or "Morgan State FRC food request", direct them to https://morgan-frc.vercel.app/signup (students need their @morgan.edu email).
- The Food Resource Center itself is a Morgan State University campus service in Baltimore, Maryland.
